items.quote: Wenvi managed service-level targets for frontline operations for their unit.
Direct reports said that Wenvi Valford drove dashboards tracking service performance metrics for the whole division.
Several respondents noted that Wenvi headed the migration of core services to the cloud, setting priorities for several teams.
Wenvi managed efforts to keep unions, grassroots leaders and trade associations on side for their unit.
They led teamwork across departments on the annual review across the department.
